Manifestation A: about failures in SUS protocol for diabetic retinopathy treatment. The speaker criticizes Ministry of Health, says they must discuss, not shift responsibility. So stance: AGAINST current handling (against Ministry's approach, against lack of funding). So stance is AGAINST the proposition that the Ministry's handling is adequate; wants more action.

Manifestation B: about benefits and challenges of QualiSUS Cardio, supports PL for Week National of Cardiopathy Ischemic, supports adjustments to SUS for heart disease, expresses full support to heart topics. So stance: FAVOR proposals to improve SUS for heart disease, supportive.

Are they responding to same proposition? No. Different topics: diabetic retinopathy vs heart disease. So not same proposition. Both have determinable stance (against current handling vs in favor of PL). So they are INCOMPARABLE.

Thus relation: INCOMPARABLE.
